description: Author the six stoichiometry seed lessons (AP Chem / college level) as a shipped .lesson bundle that dogfoods the FEAT-001 import+validate path, including the REQUIRED AI-authored figures (genmedia gemini-3-pro-image first, deterministic-SVG-rendered-to-PNG as a flagged fallback). Produces scripts/author-seed-lessons.* + scripts/seed/*.json + figure PNGs + src-tauri/resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson + docs/LESSONS_AUTHORING.md, and the seed-rigor assertions in lessons/tests.rs. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (needs the bundle writer, validate_bundle, and the explainer recompute functions). Must land before FEAT-003 can show real content, but FEAT-003 can be built against FEAT-001's test fixtures if needed.
steps: Create scripts/seed/figures.manifest.json (per figure: id, prompt, model 'gemini-3-pro-image', artDirection, targetSize, reviewedBy, sha256). Generate >=1 required figure PNG per lesson (>=6 total) with the genmedia image MCP tool (tool_id genmedia-nanobanana::nanobanana_image_generation, model gemini-3-pro-image / 'Nano Banana Pro'), art-directed to DESIGN.md: hazard yellow #facc15 on matte black, clean labeled scientific illustration, sentence-case labels, legible at 2x. Optimize/downscale so the six-lesson seed set stays < ~40 MB. FALLBACK (if genmedia unavailable in the environment): author a high-quality deterministic SVG per figure and rasterize it to PNG, and FLAG this prominently in `findings` and the step report — a figure-free lesson is NEVER acceptable.

Author scripts/seed/lessonset.json + scripts/seed/lessons/<id>.json for the six lessons: (1) moles/molar mass/Avogadro + conversions, hero mole-ratio calculator; (2) balancing equations, hero equation balancer, checkpoint bank has >=1 balance-kind item; (3) mole ratios & stoichiometric calcs, hero mole-ratio step-reveal + dimensional-analysis railroad; (4) limiting reagent & percent yield, hero limiting-reagent bars; (5) solution stoichiometry molarity/dilution/titration, hero titration curve; (6) gas stoichiometry ideal gas law + molar volume at STP, hero ideal-gas PV explorer. Each lesson: objectives->concepts, 2-5 explainers INCLUDING >=1 figure-kind explainer backed by a decoding PNG, 3+ worked examples with step reveal, a common-misconceptions explainer, an adaptive trainer with seeded generators, a checkpoint from an over-provisioned bank (>=2x presented, >=2 items/concept).

Author the cumulative final exam bank: >=60 items (>=18 MC / >=18 numeric / >=9 multistep, >=2 items/concept) spanning all six lessons, draw mix 12 MC / 12 numeric / 0 balance / 6 multistep (sums to 30), 80% to pass, unlocked only after all six checkpoints >=80%. Multistep items chain concepts across lessons (balance->mole ratio->grams; limiting reagent->percent yield->gas volume at STP). The union of explainer kinds across the six lessons must include all 7 interactive FR-EXP kinds. CHEMISTRY MUST BE CORRECT: every equation balances (atoms + charge), every molar mass correct to 2 decimals, every worked-example/item answer key recomputes consistently.

Create scripts/author-seed-lessons.* (authoring tool, NOT compiled into the app binary) that reads scripts/seed/*.json + the figure PNGs, calls the FEAT-001 bundle writer, and emits src-tauri/resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson (create the resources/seed/ dir). Re-running the script with the same manifest reproduces the same bundle.

Create docs/LESSONS_AUTHORING.md: the figure accuracy-review checklist (§12.2), the figure manifest format (§12.1), and the seed-authoring procedure, with the named human seed-content-reviewer signoff recorded and stamped into each Figure.reviewedBy.

Extend src-tauri/src/lessons/tests.rs with the seed-rigor assertions: seed-dogfood (stoichiometry.lesson passes validate_bundle with zero errors via import_bundle; every answer key recomputes); required-figure floor (each of 6 lessons >=1 figure-kind explainer whose figureId resolves and whose PNG decodes at declared width x height with matching byte-hash); FR-EXP union completeness (all 7 interactive kinds present); item-bank floors (checkpoint >=2x with >=2 items/concept; exam >=60 with >=18/>=18/>=9, mix sums to 30, mix.balance==0); balance-kind checkpoint floor (Lesson 2 checkpoint >=1 balance item; every equation_balancer-taught concept covered by >=1 balance item); backend offline take-test (network client stubbed to fail; full take->exam->certificate succeeds); every seed Figure.reviewedBy non-empty.
acceptance_criteria: src-tauri/resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson exists and passes validate_bundle with zero errors through the ordinary import_bundle path
Each of the six lessons embeds >=1 figure-kind explainer backed by a PNG that decodes at its declared dimensions (no figure-free lesson)
`cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib` passes the seed-dogfood + required-figure-floor + FR-EXP-union + item-bank-floor + balance-checkpoint-floor + backend-offline-take tests
If the genmedia tool was unavailable and SVG-fallback figures were used, that is clearly flagged in findings and in the step report
